question: By whose grace is the determination of Kaula known?
premises: The speaker knows the determination of Kaula.
This knowledge comes by your grace.
The addressee is lord of the Kaulas.
inference: Kaula doctrine is known through the grace of the Kaula lord.
uncertainties: The specific doctrinal content of kaula-nirṇaya is not stated.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have known the determination of Kaula.
